definitions.explanation: The act of taking prescribed medicine, especially on a regular basis as part of treatment.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{決|き}まった{時間|じかん}に{服薬|ふくやく}する。
examples.english: Take medicine at the same time every day.

examples.japanese: {服薬|ふくやく}を{忘|わす}れないように{アラームを{設定|せってい}した。
examples.english: I set an alarm so I don't forget to take my medicine.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{服薬|ふくやく}{管理|かんり}は{家族|かぞく}のサポートが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Family support is important for managing medication for elderly people.

notes:
{服薬|ふくやく} is a formal/medical term for taking medicine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服薬|ふくやく}する: to take medicine
- {服薬|ふくやく}{管理|かんり}: medication management
- {服薬|ふくやく}{指導|しどう}: medication guidance
- {服薬|ふくやく}スケジュール: medication schedule
- {服薬|ふくやく}{アドヒアランス}: medication adherence

RELATED TERMS:
- {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む: to take medicine (common)
- {投薬|とうやく}: administering medicine (by medical staff)
- {処方|しょほう}: prescription

USAGE NOTE:
{服薬|ふくやく} is more formal than {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む and is commonly used in medical settings and healthcare discussions.
